sequence_points.name: Abstract Botanical Composition
sequence_points.description: A minimalist abstract painting featuring stylized green leaf-like forms on a pale background, mounted vertically on a wall. The composition uses soft, muted tones with subtle pink accents and a simple, clean layout.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Botanical Forms
sequence_points.description: Two abstract paintings featuring simplified green and dark leaf-like forms on a light background, mounted side by side on a neutral wall. The larger painting on the left displays vertical elongated shapes with rounded elements, while the smaller one on the right contains more clustered, organic forms.
